checkpoints.name: IDEMPOTENCY
checkpoints.finding: All write operations use overwrite mode.

checkpoints.name: ERROR_HANDLING
checkpoints.finding: Each pipeline stage is wrapped in try/except.

checkpoints.name: PARTITION_PRUNING
checkpoints.finding: Read operations are filtered by date/partition column.

checkpoints.name: ROW_COUNT_LOGGING
checkpoints.finding: Row count is not logged after each transformation stage.
checkpoints.fix: Add logging statements to log row counts after each transformation stage.

checkpoints.name: BUSINESS_RULES
checkpoints.finding: Revenue is calculated as SUM(amount) WHERE status='COMPLETED'.

checkpoints.name: NULL_HANDLING
checkpoints.finding: NULL checks are present on transaction_id but not on other critical columns.
checkpoints.fix: Add NULL checks on other critical columns.

checkpoints.name: BROADCAST_HINT
checkpoints.finding: broadcast() is used on the merchant dimension join.

checkpoints.name: HARDCODED_PATHS
checkpoints.finding: File paths are hardcoded as strings instead of parameters.
checkpoints.fix: Use parameters for file paths instead of hardcoding them.

checkpoints.name: SCHEMA_VALIDATION
checkpoints.finding: There is no check that expected columns exist before transforming.
checkpoints.fix: Add schema validation to check for expected columns before transforming.

checkpoints.name: DEDUPLICATION
checkpoints.finding: Explicit dedup logic on transaction_id is present.

checkpoints.name: METADATA_OUTPUT
checkpoints.finding: The pipeline writes a run summary JSON at the end.

checkpoints.name: IMPORTS
checkpoints.finding: All imports are present and specific.
